item: B5. DEU Wulfen 41 MW (MBBF) — position and units
note_zh: GEM 的 Wulfen 座標（51.197, 11.966，與 Burg (NOTUS) 共用的概略點）在 Teuchern 附近，那裡沒有 MBBF 的機組；Wulfen 在安哈特—比特費爾德縣 Osternienburger Land，MBBF 在當地是 Dornbock（10 部 Enron 1.5s，2002）與 Kleinpaschleben（12 部，2002），本站已各有紀錄。
note_en: GEM’s Wulfen point (51.197, 11.966, an approximate point shared with Burg (NOTUS)) is near Teuchern, where MBBF has no turbines; Wulfen lies in Osternienburger Land (Anhalt-Bitterfeld), where MBBF runs Dornbock (10 Enron 1.5s, 2002) and Kleinpaschleben (12, 2002), both already separate records.
why: MaStR: MBBF Windpark GmbH & Co. KG has Windpark Dornbock (10 × Enron Wind 1.5s, 19.02–12.03.2002, 15 MW) and Windpark Kleinpaschleben (12 × 1.5s, 12.06–16.07.2002, 18 MW) in Osternienburger Land; site records "Dornbock" (26 MW, 2002/2021) and "Kleinpaschleben" (18 MW, 2002, owner EOS) exist. 15 + 18 = 33 MW ≠ GEM’s 41 MW, so Wulfen cannot be called a duplicate yet; MBBF’s own Windpark Wulfen page (GEM’s source) is gone (404) and web.archive.org is blocked from here. turbines_de.json gives Wulfen 18 unrelated units near Teuchern (1994–2022, 11 models) through the build’s capacity budget around the wrong point — Wulfen’s match there is wrong either way. Next: MBBF portfolio list from another archive, or a press item naming Windpark Wulfen’s turbines.

Betriebs KG, has only 13 Nordex N100 in the Marktstammdatenregister (2.5 MW each, 32.5 MW, i.e. the Buchhainer Heide record’s 33 MW: eight in 2014, five in 2016); the four of them in Oelsig (Schlieben), commissioned in August–September 2016, make exactly this record’s 10 MW', 'https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Einheit/EinheitJson/GetErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung?sort=&page=1&pageSize=500&group=&filter=Name%20des%20Anlagenbetreibers%20(nur%20Org.)~ct~%27Buchhainer%27')
note_zh: GEM 依 MaStR 的鄉鎮把同一座 WP Buchhain 拆成兩筆（Doberlug-Kirchhain 9 部、Schlieben 4 部），其中 Schlieben 的 4 部已含在 Buchhainer Heide 的 2016 年分期。
note_en: GEM split the one WP Buchhain by MaStR municipality (nine units in Doberlug-Kirchhain, four in Schlieben); the four in Schlieben are already inside Buchhainer Heide’s 2016 phase.
why: Not written in round 21: GEM took this record’s point from the 2018 Gamesa G114 farm, so the record may stand for that farm rather than part of Buchhainer Heide. MaStR operator query: 13 units, all "WP Buchhain" N100: Buc 01–05, 07, 10, 11 (03.11–09.12.2014, Doberlug-Kirchhain), Buc 12 (11.08.2016, Buchhain) and Buc 06, 09, 14, 17 (25.08–14.09.2016, Gemarkung Oelsig, Gemeinde Schlieben) = 4 × 2.5 = 10 MW. GEM’s Buchhainer Heide phases (2014 20 MW at 51.6565, 13.3458; 2016 13 MW at 51.6640, 13.3609) cover all 13. Caveat: GEM took this record’s point (51.6640, 13.3920) from a The Wind Power entry for the 2018 Gamesa G114 farm, which sits by Bärfang’s units; the G114 farm is the separate "Bärfang (Schleswig-Holstein)" record (16 MW, 8 units — misnamed, it is in Brandenburg), and 2 more G114 (Windpark Buchhain 8 & 11, 4 MW, June 2018) plus BUC 07 (eno100, 2.2 MW, 2014) and TWS KG Oelsig (3 × V90, 6 MW) have no record of their own. The identification rests on GEM’s operator (cited to MaStR) and the exact 10 MW; if the main session prefers, keep the record and only note it.

farm: R3 Bilecik-6 / R3-Ankara-2-1 / R3-Elaziğ-1 / R3-Bayburt-5 wind farm
proposal: (no rule yet: built or not is unproven; GEM’s "operating" rests on the EPDK licence)
note_zh: Kalyon 官網四案都寫「2024 年第一季起施工、預計 2024 年第三或第四季全容量併網」，是計畫用語；沒有找到完工或併網的出處。
note_en: Kalyon’s pages for all four say construction from Q1 2024 with full capacity planned in Q3 or Q4 2024 — planning language; no source on completion or grid connection found.
why: Kalyon Holding project pages (live) give licence size and the 2024 plan only; the Enercon contract (June/Nov 2023: 64 E-138 EP3, 260 MW for Elazığ, Bilecik, Bayburt, Ankara, Trabzon) is a supply deal. Searches for "devreye alındı/geçici kabul/işletmeye alındı" found nothing; TÜREB’s 2023+ lists are members-only. Note Kalyon gives R3-Bayburt-5 as 40 MWe installed (GEM 43 MW). If the main session wants an interim status, st=1 (construction) is consistent with Kalyon’s own pages, but completion is unknown either way.
